svg.title: IoT streaming analytics on AWS
svg.desc: IoT streaming analytics on AWS. 11 components in 8 groups. Connections: Sensors to AWS IoT Greengrass; AWS IoT Greengrass to AWS IoT Core (MQTT); AWS IoT Core to Amazon Kinesis Data Streams; Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to Anomaly detection; Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to Amazon Data Firehose; Amazon Kinesis Data Streams to Amazon Timestream; Anomaly detection to Alerts topic; Amazon Data Firehose to Data lake; Data lake to Amazon OpenSearch Service (index); Amazon Timestream to Amazon Managed Grafana (query); Amazon OpenSearch Service to Amazon Managed Grafana.

text.tspan: Sensor telemetry flows through AWS IoT Core into Amazon Kinesis Data Streams, which feeds real-time alerts, a data lake and a time-series store
